title: Portfolio Website
description: My portfolio website showcases my expertise in technical writing and frontend development. It features projects, skills, an about section, and a contact page, offering a seamless and engaging way for clients and employers to explore my work.

title: Weather Forecast Application
description: The Weather Forecast App provides real-time weather updates worldwide. Users can search by city or GPS to view temperature, humidity, wind speed, and a 5-day forecast, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information.

title: Ping Pong Game Application
description: The Ping Pong Game App replicates classic table tennis with smooth animations, AI and multiplayer modes, score tracking, and adjustable difficulty. Built with modern web tech, it offers a seamless gaming experience across devices.

title: Lagos State Image Gallery
description: The Lagos State Image Gallery showcases Lagos' culture, landmarks, and landscapes through high-quality photos. With themed categories and an easy interface, it offers a visual tour for tourists, historians, and locals.

title: Blockchain Quiz Application
description: The Blockchain Quiz App tests and enhances blockchain knowledge through interactive quizzes on crypto, DeFi, and smart contracts. Users can track progress, compete on leaderboards, and earn badges, making learning engaging and fun.

title: People Counter Application
description: The People Counter App tracks real-time foot traffic for stores, events, and public spaces. It provides accurate visitor data, peak times, and occupancy insights via a user-friendly dashboard and customizable reports to optimize operations and safety.
